description: .NET Analyzer Configuration for C# 12/13 Best Practices

design.description: Design issues - API design, type design, naming

usage.description: Usage issues - API usage, performance, disposable

CA1000.description: Do not declare static members on generic types

CA1001.description: Types that own disposable fields should be disposable

CA1012.description: Abstract types should not have public constructors

CA1014.reason: Not all assemblies need CLS compliance

CA1031.description: Do not catch general exception types

CA1034.description: Nested types should not be visible

CA1062.reason: Nullable reference types handle this. DI parameters should NOT be null-checked.

CA1303.description: Do not pass literals as localized parameters

CA1711.description: Identifiers should not have incorrect suffix

CA1810.description: Initialize reference type static fields inline

CA1826.description: Use property instead of Linq Enumerable method

CA1827.description: Do not use Count/LongCount when Any can be used

CA1828.description: Do not use CountAsync/LongCountAsync when AnyAsync can be used

CA1829.description: Use Length/Count property instead of Enumerable.Count method

CA1830.description: Prefer strongly-typed Append and Insert method overloads on StringBuilder

CA1831.description: Use AsSpan instead of Range-based indexers for string

CA1832.description: Use AsSpan or AsMemory instead of Range-based indexers

CA1833.description: Use AsSpan or AsMemory instead of Range-based indexers

CA1834.description: Use StringBuilder.Append(char) for single character strings

CA1835.description: Prefer the memory-based overloads of ReadAsync/WriteAsync methods

CA1836.description: Prefer IsEmpty over Count when available

CA1842.description: Do not use WhenAll with a single task

CA1843.description: Do not use WaitAll with a single task

CA1844.description: Provide memory-based overrides of async methods when subclassing Stream

CA1847.description: Use string.Contains(char) instead of string.Contains(string) with single characters

CA1848.description: Use LoggerMessage delegates for high-performance logging

CA1849.description: Call async methods when in an async method

CA1850.description: Prefer static HashData method over ComputeHash

CA2002.description: Do not lock on objects with weak identity

CA2007.description: Do not directly await a Task (consider ConfigureAwait)
CA2007.reason: Not needed in .NET 6+ apps with new synchronization context

CA2008.description: Do not create tasks without passing a TaskScheduler

CA2013.description: Do not use ReferenceEquals with value types

CA2014.description: Do not use stackalloc in loops

CA2015.description: Do not define finalizers for types derived from MemoryManager<T>

CA2016.description: Forward CancellationToken parameter to methods that take one

CA2017.description: Parameter count mismatch between format string and arguments

CA2100.description: Review SQL queries for security vulnerabilities

CA2201.description: Do not raise reserved exception types

CA2207.description: Initialize value type static fields inline

CA2211.description: Non-constant fields should not be visible

CA2214.description: Do not call overridable methods in constructors

CA2215.description: Dispose methods should call base class dispose

CA2217.description: Do not mark enums with FlagsAttribute

CA2219.description: Do not raise exceptions in exception clauses

CA2227.description: Collection properties should be read only
CA2227.reason: Init-only properties are preferred in modern C#

CA2231.description: Overload operator equals on overriding ValueType.Equals

CA2234.description: Pass System.Uri objects instead of strings

CA2241.description: Provide correct arguments to formatting methods

CA2243.description: Attribute string literals should parse correctly

CA2244.description: Do not duplicate indexed element initializations

CA2245.description: Do not assign a property to itself

CA2246.description: Do not assign a symbol and its member in the same statement

CA2247.description: Argument passed to TaskCompletionSource constructor should be TaskCreationOptions enum

CA2248.description: Provide correct enum argument to Enum.HasFlag

CA2249.description: Consider using String.Contains instead of String.IndexOf

CA3001.description: Review code for SQL injection vulnerabilities

CA3077.description: Insecure Processing in API Design, XML Document and XML Text Reader

CA5350.description: Do Not Use Weak Cryptographic Algorithms

CA5351.description: Do Not Use Broken Cryptographic Algorithms

CA5360.description: Do Not Call Dangerous Methods In Deserialization

CA5361.description: Do Not Disable SChannel Use of Strong Crypto

CA5362.description: Potential reference cycle in deserialized object graph

CA5364.description: Do Not Use Deprecated Security Protocols

CA5365.description: Do Not Disable HTTP Header Checking

collection_expressions.description: Convert arrays and lists to collection expressions [1, 2, 3]

primary_constructors.description: Use primary constructors for simple classes

pattern_matching.description: Prefer switch expressions over switch statements

required_members.description: Use required members for mandatory properties

no_di_null_checks.description: Remove null checks from DI constructor parameters - trust the container
